title: The Swallow and the Crow
summary: A swallow boasted of her glossy spring plumage to a crow....
full_text:
A swallow boasted of her glossy spring plumage to a crow.

The crow replied: "Your feathers are fair in the sunny warmth of spring, but when the bitter frosts of winter arrive, you must flee across the sea; my sturdy black coat endures the storm, keeping me warm and constant all year round!"
moral: Beauty that endures through winter storms is far more valuable than the fleeting glory of spring.
